capabilities: Insert a streak code block that renders a GitHub-style heatmap in a note
Mark or unmark days by clicking, keyboard, or touch
Log numeric points per day in detailed mode with a popup point editor
Sync completed markdown tasks to daily points via date badges
Customize board color, statistics display, and full-width layout
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; data is stored locally in the plugin's data.json, and downgrading below version 1.3 permanently clears detailed task breakdowns.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually track daily habits or streaks inside notes without external habit-tracking apps or services.
summary: Clickable GitHub-style heatmap that renders in notes via a streak code block to track habits, streaks, and daily numeric goals.
